name: Odoo
description: All-in-one open source business apps, from CRM and sales to accounting and inventory

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Everything Odoo keeps: the PostgreSQL database (postgres/), the file store with attachments (odoo/), your own add-on modules (addons/) and the secret keys (state/). Back this folder up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Odoo web app, published on host as 6156

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: ODOO_MASTER_PASSWORD
variables.description: The master password. Odoo asks for it when you create, back up, restore or delete a database. Leave it blank and the app makes a random one on first start. It is shown in the app log and saved in the data folder. Or type your own.
